concepts.name: 에나멜 능력 휘장
concepts.build: 단순 휘장 메시 + 기존 능력 아이콘 + 바닥 하이라이트 + 짧은 획득 트레일
concepts.design: Create TWO chunky sculpted SHIELD-SHAPED PICKUP EMBLEMS, clearly collectible tokens rather than a UI window: a compact rounded pentagonal silhouette with only a few beveled edges, solid thickness visible, satin ivory-silver rim, deep navy inset. Left has a large raised rounded TEAL HEART symbol; right a large raised AMBER SWORD symbol. A small discreet shoe-sole stamp on the metal bottom edge connects the items to footwear upgrades. No text inside objects, no filigree, no bolts all over. The health and attack emblems float upright at knee height, tilted slightly for a 3D side edge, gently bobbing, each about a third of shark height. One fine highlight sweeps the rim. Main look: confident, elegant collectible medallion-like reward with a charming game object silhouette, not a cheap signboard or very thin flat card. Pickup: attack emblem collapses into a small warm glint then trails to shoe soles, a faint amber sword-shaped afterimage lasts briefly.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 original production-minded concept sheet for a Korean Unity mobile runner shooter, TRALALERO SHOOTER. The user wants an attractive, cohesive, premium-looking pickup with a realistic solo-developer construction path. Learn only the immediate left/right choice readability and visible power feedback from the runner genre. Do not copy any commercial game artwork.
INPUT IMAGE: provided screenshot is an environment, camera and character identity reference ONLY. Match the familiar warm-brown timber pier, blue-white seafood stalls, bright blue sea, thin ink outlines and cel-shaded game rendering. Retain the EXACT shark identity and sneaker arrangement from the reference: two feet plus the tail ending in a sneaker. Do not invent a fourth shoe, extra limb, backpack or costume.
COMPOSITION: clean cream/navy presentation with minimal chrome. Top slim header exact title below. LEFT about 58% width: large portrait MAIN GAMEPLAY VIEW, existing elevated rear camera, the actual shark fully visible at bottom and TWO distinct collectible choices in the lane ahead. Items are below waist high, readable from a distance, with visible gap. Show some clear path beyond. Labels tidy and subordinate to item shape: left compact label "체력 +13", right compact label "공격력 +14%". No full-width banner, no gate, no table or pedestal. RIGHT about 42%: upper close-up panel labelled "형태" shows the two SAME designed objects at 3/4 angle on neutral warm ivory background, enough to judge bevels, materials and construction. Lower panel labelled "획득" shows selected RIGHT item fading away near the same shark, TWO short soft warm-gold trails or simple soft swipe moving into sneaker soles, one small fading ground ring, compact text "공격력 +14%". Unchosen choice quietly fades. No diagram arrows or explanatory paragraphs. Header small note exact "제작 시안". Right close-up and gameplay objects MUST match.
ART QUALITY: cohesive collectible design through a strong silhouette, substantial but simple beveled edges, controlled gloss on enamel, satin metal, clean face icons, restrained wear only at corners. High quality stylized real-time 3D, not faceted crude placeholder blocks, not photorealism. Shape and lighting do the work; details remain large enough for mobile. Shading can be realized with ordinary mesh bevels, existing cel-shaded materials and sprites. Use the game's established navy + warm ivory, teal health accent and amber attack accent. Gold accent limited to edges/glints. Distinct contact shadow and a very small flat ground highlight identify pickup location; no giant magic circle.
FEASIBILITY: each object assembles from 2-5 simple rigid parts, existing stat icon sprites and simple geometric meshes; no cloth simulation, no fine sculpture, no procedural liquids, no fluid simulation, no custom character rig, no glass refraction. Pickup animation needs only scale/rotation/fade and two short trails. These are concepts, not actual imported prefabs.
WORLD/CONTEXT: collectibles are conventional temporary upgrade objects embedded in the already-established journey and footwear-modification theme. No new deity lore or depicted origin story. Background stays a believable place, not a floating abstract race track. No dropped medical pouch, no loose wrench or cog on the floor. No gosa table, no pig head, no candles, no shrine, no column, no resurrection gate, no tall banner, no loot chest filled with coins. No poisonous smoke, no stars/confetti, no huge beams, no blue sci-fi floor portal, no screen-wide bloom. Do not rebuild the harbor or put obstacles around the pickups.

concepts.name: 신발 개조 모듈
concepts.build: 작은 케이스·덧창·앞코 메시 + 기존 아이콘/TMP + 축소·흡수 연출
concepts.design: Create TWO compact OPEN FOOTWEAR MODIFICATION CASES. Each case is knee-low, navy lower shell and warm ivory upper inset, rounded rectangular hard case with one simple open hinged lid, a single brass latch and thick soft bevels. No complicated interior machinery. Left presents ONE small curved TEAL REINFORCED SOLE INSERT with clear shoe-tread geometry; the inner lid carries one white HEART icon. Right presents ONE small AMBER METAL TOE-CAP INSERT with a restrained front ridge and beveled shape; inner lid carries one white SWORD icon. These are specific recognizable shoe upgrade parts, not an ordinary medical kit or toolbox, and parts are visibly matched to the player's existing sneaker proportions. Cases low and forward-facing, one insert hovering a few centimeters above its padded recess; no tall backing plate, no big hard floor plinth. They occupy the left and right lane cleanly. Detailed close-up shows exactly case shell, lid and ONE part each. Main look premium stylized workshop kit, clear navy-ivory materials and strong contrasting teal/amber parts. Pickup: selected toe-cap becomes a brief amber ghost outline at the existing shoe toe, case fades, then the original shoe appearance returns; no persistent new equipment implied. Two short light trails, no magical fireworks.

concepts.name: 입체 아이콘 성장 카드
concepts.build: 기존 나인슬라이스·아이콘 + 얇은 카드 메시 + 회전·페이드·빛 연출
concepts.design: Create TWO FLOATING PORTRAIT UPGRADE CARDS with the craft quality of a finished collectible game: softly clipped top corners, thick satin ivory rim with a narrow dark-blue bevel, solid navy enamel face, warm metal side thickness. Large three-dimensional relief icon occupies about 60% of each face: simple teal HEART at left, single amber SWORD at right. Lower 20% of each face has precisely centered compact Korean info: left '체력' and '+13', right '공격력' and '+14%'. Because the information is INSIDE these cards, omit the external labels in the main gameplay view to avoid duplication. No stars, rarity diamonds, level badges, tiny stat rows or decorative flourishes. Cards stand unsupported just above the floor at lower-body height and angle a few degrees toward the camera with a clean cast shadow; slim enough not to feel like a wall or doorway. They have rich but restrained form through a rounded rim and embossed icon, NOT flat featureless rectangles or tall banners. Main look refined layered UI/object hybrid that is realistic to build with a thin card mesh, reusable 9-slice border and lit icon plane. Pickup: selected card rotates edge-on and dissolves into TWO short amber swipes toward shoes; one crisp compact '+14%' feedback beside the character, with no enormous particle effect.
